title: The provider sign-out's answers and its sweep
assertion: A claim counts the try and leases the row; done records `provider_signed_out`; a failed try waits 1, 5, 15, then 60 minutes; a row is late once at five tries, or four with no running lease, and given up at 30 tries or at 24 hours with four tries, never while a lease runs and never untried; `provider_sign_out_undelivered` is written once under overlapping runs; a late or given-up row is returned on every run until its line is acknowledged; rows done 90 days ago and given-up rows 90 days after their line are deleted, never an undone row
noFileReason: Synthetic accounts and a provider twin the tests make; no file.
